patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Instantly and Lusha share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Instantly and Lusha share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Instantly only if your buying job matches “Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358” rather than Lusha's shape. Choose Lusha only if your buying job matches “B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and” rather than Instantly's shape. Workflow advantage: Instantly leans sales-engagement; Lusha leans contact-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Instantly and Lusha share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Instantly is Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358; bundles/credits add-ons; Enterprise custom.; Lusha is B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and Engage outreach sequences..
- Workflow coverage skew: Instantly-leaning sales-engagement vs Lusha-leaning contact-management.
- Researched limits: Instantly — Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; Lusha — Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene..

Limitations — Instantly: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; Lead finder/credits are add-on depth vs dedicated SI databases; Lusha: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.; Credit-based consumption for reveals/signals/API; unused annual credits do not roll over..

Poor-fit cases: Instantly is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core · Lusha is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene. · Avoid Instantly if you actually need Lusha's motion (B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, si)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
